rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof structure (shingles on back porch overhang) is straightforward property damage to the home.
claim_summary: Policyholder Jordan Lee reports wind damage to back porch overhang—four shingles blown off during last weekend's storm. No interior water damage. Estimated repair cost is $400, but note that the deductible is $2,500, so this claim does not meet the threshold for coverage benefit.

case_facts.description: four shingles blown off roof, no interior water damage
